film.title: Frankenstein — Living Engraving V5.3-dev
film.visual_baseline: V5.1 complete baseline; V5.3 hybrid lookdev active

shots.purpose: Locate the story in a recognisable historical Ingolstadt and direct attention toward Victor's fictional laboratory context. Exterior art remains unresolved until a high-information location-specific candidate passes.
Sparse creation chamber: creature under drapery, dying practical light, period-inspired apparatus, Gothic window, and Victor held at architectural distance. No generic shelf/book/skull filler.
Medium/full-body recoil at an arched doorway. Use physical occlusion and local shadow; no forced portrait enlargement.
Macro apparatus shot: voltaic-pile interpretation, Leyden-jar context, copper wiring, and a controllable brass contact/lever. No weak hand insert.
Extreme close-up: engraved face emerges from darkness; dull-yellow/watery eye is revealed with JavaScript occlusion rather than neon glow.
Return to the sparse chamber as the creature shows restrained first movement and Victor recoils; preserve unresolved articulation honestly rather than faking complex limb motion.
